blocks.text: LUCENA CITY — A reticulated python, locally known as “sawa,” was captured inside a house in Tayabas City, Quezon, on Tuesday. The Tayabas City Environment and Natural Resources Office (ENRO) said the non-venomous snake was caught in Barangay Angeles Zone-IV at 11:34 a.m. According to the Department of Environment and Natural Resources (DENR), the reticulated python is classified as an “Other Threatened Species,” meaning it faces threats like poaching or animal hoarding by collectors and could eventually be classified as “Vulnerable” if these threats persist.
